name: BECCS post-harvest forest-pool screening sensitivity
scope: Presentation-level screening calculation; not a calibrated forest carbon model
screened_pools: harvest residues and dead organic matter
timing_treatment: Not propagated into the FaIR response until a site-specific flux magnitude and time profile are available
